summary: Kodiak Gas Services files a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of 10,563,380 shares of common stock at $71.00 per share, with a 30-day greenshoe option for up to 1,584,507 additional shares. The stock closed at $75.14 on May 12, 2026, implying a 5.5% discount. Proceeds of ~$727.5M before expenses go to the issuer. Underwriters include Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan. No special-situation catalyst; this is a routine capital raise for a public company. For risk arbitrageurs, there is no M&A angle; watch share price and underwriter exercise post-offer.
